and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

translations.web: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
translations.bsb: The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.
translations.kjv: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.
translations.asv: Jehovah maketh poor, and maketh rich: He bringeth low, he also lifteth up.
